content.title: Telus to buy remaining digital unit stake for $539 million
content.summary: The company has offered $4.50 per share to buy the Telus Digital shares it does not own and take the unit private.  Telus is taking full ownership of its digital services unit, which offers IT services, to better integrate the subsidiary's AI and software capabilities.  The digital unit's shareholders will get an option to either get $4.50 in cash, 0.273 Telus share, or half of each in cash and stock.
